steps: Go to https://www.onlineverdict.com/jurors/signup/ and fill in the form: first and last name, email, state, county, cell phone, date of birth, and annual household income.
Read and agree to the Terms and Conditions (confidentiality, only you participate under your profile, paid only if you answer all questions).
Wait for an email or text when a case is posted in your area — participation is 100% optional.
If you are available, complete the case screener; if you match the demographics, your spot in the study is confirmed.
Review the case materials (surveys, Zoom presentations, or in-person sessions) and answer every case question thoroughly and completely.
Note the payment terms you are told ahead of time for that specific case (typical pay $30-$350, varies by study length).
Make sure your correct name and mailing address are registered on the site so your payment reaches you.
timing: Not stated in the official terms — you are only told you will be informed of the payment terms for each case ahead of time.
